C1_text_fidelity.rule: phrase recall >= 0.98 on every SC/MX text page AND no regression vs baseline > 1 pp

C2_reading_order.rule: all left sentinels before all right sentinels, both TC docs (docling)

C3_tables.rule: both TB fixtures: grid dims exact AND cell recovery >= 0.90 (docling)

C4_ocr.rule: phrase recall >= 0.90 on scan fixture (docling OCR)

C6_time.rule: median wall <= 60 s/doc (docling, run2 steady state)

C8_managed_runtime.rule: venv + weights <= 2 GB, OCR backend pip-only, cold start <= 120 s, warm <= 10 s/doc
C8_managed_runtime.notes: venv = installed footprint of the pinned stack on Windows/Python 3.12 (torch 2.14.0+cpu included); weights = what this pipeline config downloads/uses (layout heron onnx+torch variants, tableformer set, RapidOCR PP-OCRv6). Packaging could drop the unused torch variant of the layout model.
